{"data":[{"id":158,"category_id":19,"title":"Payouts: when online payments reach your barangay","content":"When a resident pays online for a document or a bill, the money first clears with the payment provider, Xendit. BarangayOS then sends your barangay's share to the e-wallet set in **Settings** > **Payments**. Money for a document request is held until the document is released. **Finance** > **Payouts** shows where each online payment stands.

**For:** every staff role, to read. Setting the e-wallet is for admins. **Where:** Staff dashboard > **Finance** > **Payouts**.

## Who can see it

- The **Payouts** page needs "View Payouts". A new barangay gives it to all four default roles.
- The e-wallet the money goes to is set in **Settings** > **Payments**, which needs "View Settings" to open and "Edit Settings" to change. A new barangay gives these to Super Admin and Admin.
- Cash never passes through payouts. It stays with the barangay from the start.

## How an online payment reaches your barangay

- The resident pays online, with GCash, Maya or GrabPay. The request or the bill turns paid at once, and a receipt is made.
- Xendit clears the payment. Until it does, the payment is **Pending Settlement**.
- For a document request, the cleared money is held until staff release the document. It shows as **Held for Release**. A bill has nothing to release, so it skips this.
- Once cleared, and released for a document, the money is **Ready to Disburse**. BarangayOS sends it to your barangay's e-wallet by itself.
- The payout shows under **Recent Payouts** as **Succeeded**, and counts in **Total Disbursed**.

## How long it takes

The barangay's share is sent "usually 2 to 3 days after payment. For a document, once it is also released." The **Payouts** page says the same.

- The time to clear depends on how the resident paid. A payment made on a Friday, a weekend or a holiday can take longer.
- BarangayOS checks for cleared payments every 4 hours, so a payout can follow a few hours after the money clears.
- For a document, the money is not sent before its release, however long ago the resident paid. Releasing a document whose money has cleared sends it right away.

Your barangay receives what the resident paid minus the platform fee. The amounts on the **Payouts** page are your barangay's share.

If a paid document request is cancelled or rejected before its release, the money goes back to the resident as a refund instead of to your barangay. See [Reject or cancel a request](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/staff-reject-or-cancel).

## What the Payouts page shows

| Figure | What it counts |
|---|---|
| **Pending Settlement** | Paid online, still clearing with Xendit. All dates. |
| **Ready to Disburse** | Cleared and waiting to be sent: bills, documents already released, and blocked payouts. All dates. |
| **Held for Release** | Cleared, waiting for the document's release. It is sent by itself when you release the document. All dates. |
| **Total Disbursed** | Payouts sent to your e-wallet in the dates you picked. |
| **Failed Payouts** | Payouts that failed in the dates you picked. |

- **Pending Payouts** lists the newest online payments not paid out yet: who paid, for which document or bill, when, how, and where each stands. A payment that is owed but still clearing shows **Clearing**, and one held for its document shows **Held**.
- **Recent Payouts** lists the payouts made in the dates you picked, with a **Payout ID** and a status: **Succeeded**, **Accepted**, **Failed**, **Cancelled** or **Reversed**.
- **Receipt** on a row opens the payment's official receipt.
- The dates at the top right start at the last 30 days. They change **Total Disbursed**, **Failed Payouts** and **Recent Payouts** only.
- **Blocked Payouts** appears only when BarangayOS has stopped trying to send some money. "These payouts need manual review", and the money is withheld until it is resolved.
- **Payments to refund** appears only when an online payment paid nothing. See below.

## Payments to refund

An online payment can go through after its bill or document request was already paid, for example in cash at the hall after you cancelled the online payment, or after the bill was cancelled. That payment pays nothing. It is held: it is never paid out to your barangay and is not counted in the figures above. It must go back to the resident.

- Each payment under **Payments to refund** shows the amount, the bill or request it was for, whether it was a **Pay all** payment, the e-wallet and when it was paid.
- **Refund to resident** on a row opens a window that says how much goes back and to which e-wallet. **Refund to resident** in the window confirms it, and **Not now** leaves it.
- Bills a resident paid together with **Pay all** go back together, as one refund, because an e-wallet takes one refund per payment. Before you confirm, the window names each other bill it refunds, with its amount, and the total.
- The whole amount the resident paid goes back, platform fee included, to the e-wallet that paid it. This cannot be undone.
- The row then shows **Refund on its way**. When the refund goes through, the payment leaves the list.
- For a bill, you need "Record Invoice Payments". For a document request, you need "Record Cash Payments". Without it, the row says who can refund it.
- If a refund could not start for a passing reason (the payment provider did not answer, its balance was short, or the e-wallet was down), the button says **Try the refund again**. Trying again first checks with the payment provider whether the refund went through after all, so it is never made twice.
- Any other refusal can't be fixed by trying again, so it isn't offered: the payment provider or the e-wallet would not take the refund, or the payment's checkout was already refunded once. The row says why instead of showing the button. Chat with BarangayOS support to return the amount another way. The payment stays held meanwhile.
- These payments stay held from payouts while their refund is on its way, done, or not yet confirmed by the payment provider. Only BarangayOS support can release one to your barangay instead, and a released payment can no longer be refunded here.

## Where the money goes

- Payouts go to the e-wallet in **Settings** > **Payments**, under **Payment Configuration**: the **E-Wallet Provider**, GCash or Maya, with its **Account Number** and **Account Holder Name**.
- While no e-wallet is set, cleared money is not sent. It waits under **Ready to Disburse** until an admin sets one.
- Check the account number and name carefully. A payout to wrong details can fail.

## Troubleshooting

| You see | Why | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| Money stays under **Held for Release** | The document has not been released yet. | Release the document when it is ready. See [Release a document](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/staff-release-document). |
| Money stays under **Ready to Disburse** | Your barangay has no e-wallet set, the next payout has not run yet, or the payout is blocked. A blocked payout also shows under **Blocked Payouts**. | Ask your admin to check **Settings** > **Payments**. For a blocked payout, chat with BarangayOS support. |
| **Blocked Payouts** shows a payment | BarangayOS stopped trying to send it. It needs a person to look at it. | Chat with BarangayOS support, and give the amount and the date shown. |
| **Failed Payouts** is more than zero | A payout did not go through. | Check the e-wallet details in **Settings** > **Payments**, then chat with BarangayOS support. |
| "No pending payouts" | Every online payment has been paid out, or none were made. | Nothing to do. |
| A payment under **Payments to refund** | It went through after its bill or request was already paid or cancelled, so it paid nothing. | Click **Refund to resident**. |
| "The payment provider refused the refund" | The payment provider did not take the refund. | Chat with BarangayOS support, and give the amount and the bill or request. |
| "The e-wallet would not take this refund" or "Its checkout was already refunded once" | The e-wallet takes one refund per payment, or the time to refund has passed. | Chat with BarangayOS support to return the amount another way. |
| "The payment provider would not take this refund" | The payment provider refused it, with the code shown in brackets. | Chat with BarangayOS support, and give the code. |
| "Something went wrong" when opening **Payouts** | Your role lacks "View Payouts". The page does not name it. | Ask your barangay admin for the permission. |

To chat with BarangayOS support, click **Feedback** in the sidebar.

## Related articles

- [Release a document](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/staff-release-document)
- [Reject or cancel a request](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/staff-reject-or-cancel)
- [Record a cash payment](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/staff-record-cash-payment)
- [Refunds](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/refunds)

Publisher","name":"Docs Publisher","thumbnail":""},"link":"hc/barangay-os/articles/staff-payouts"},{"id":157,"category_id":8,"title":"Correct your records or delete your account","content":"On your barangay's resident portal, you can change your profile photo and your email address. While your verification is pending, or once you are verified, you can also change your civil status and occupation. Your barangay office corrects everything else in your records. There is no button to delete your account: ask your barangay office, because your barangay controls your records.

## What you can change yourself
Open **My Profile** from the menu under your picture or initials at the top of the portal. There you can change:
- Your photo: tap your photo at the top of the page, then choose a new one of up to 5 MB. You see "Profile picture updated".
- Your email address: under **Email Authentication**, tap **Change**, type the new address, and tap **Send Code**. If you are asked to confirm it's you first, type the code sent to your current email or phone and tap **Continue**. Type the code sent to the new address, then tap **Verify & Update**. See [Change your email address](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/change-your-email).
- Your civil status and occupation: tap **Edit Profile**, change them, then tap **Save Changes**. You see "Profile updated successfully". **Edit Profile** shows while your verification is pending, and after you are verified.

Your mobile number cannot be changed on the website. See [Change your mobile number or recover a lost phone](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/change-your-mobile-number).

## What your barangay corrects
- Your name, birth date, gender, nationality, contact number and address show on **My Profile**, but you cannot edit them there.
- If your profile shows a "Barangay Records" section, it says: "Recorded by your barangay" and "contact the barangay office for corrections."
- To correct a detail, contact your barangay office.
- If you are not verified yet, you give your name and address when you verify your identity. Your barangay checks them with your verification. See [Verify your identity on the website](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/verify-identity-website).

## Deleting your account
- There is no button to delete your account on the website.
- Ask your barangay office. The Privacy Policy says: "For requests related to resident data, please contact your barangay first as they are the data controller."
- Your barangay can archive your record. You then cannot sign in to its resident portal: the sign-in says "This account is inactive. Please contact your barangay office."
- Your barangay can also delete your record for good. It cannot be undone. It removes your personal details, your identity checks with your ID photos and selfie, your unpaid document requests, your messages, notifications, votes and memberships, including private Bebot chats and their unsubmitted files.
- Some records stay with the barangay, because it must keep them: official receipts, payments and bills, paid document requests, complaints and ideas, SOS reports and appointments. They stay without your personal details, and future appointments are cancelled.
- An official receipt that was already issued keeps your name as it was printed on it.
- A barangay cannot delete your record while a payment, payout or refund of yours is still in progress, or while an SOS report of yours is open.
- If you moved to another barangay, you do not need to delete anything. See [Moving to another barangay](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/moving-to-another-barangay).
- A support chat is Zentech's, not your barangay's. To have one deleted, ask BarangayOS support.

## If something goes wrong
- You do not see **Edit Profile**: your profile shows "Unverified". You have not sent your verification yet, or your barangay returned it. Send it, then try again.
- **"Failed to update profile"**: check your connection, then tap **Save Changes** again.
- **"This account is inactive. Please contact your barangay office."** when you sign in: your barangay archived your record. Contact your barangay office.
- A detail under "Barangay Records" is wrong: only your barangay can change it. Contact your barangay office.

## When to ask for help
- **Contact your barangay office** to correct your records, or to ask for your record to be archived or deleted.
- **Chat with BarangayOS support** if a change you are allowed to make does not save, or to ask about a support chat. Never type an ID number in the chat.

Related: [Your data and privacy](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/your-data-and-privacy) · [Change your mobile number or recover a lost phone](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/change-your-mobile-number)

resident account belongs to one barangay, and each person has only one. When you move, you are marked as moved out of your old barangay. Your records stay there, and your mobile number is freed, so you can register in your new barangay with it.

## Mark yourself as moved out
- Sign in to your old barangay's resident portal and tap **Settings** in the bar at the bottom of the screen. On a computer, click **Settings** at the bottom of the sidebar.
- Under **Moving away**, tap **I Moved Out**. You can type your new barangay, then tap **Yes, I Moved Out**.
- You see "You are marked as moved out", and you are signed out of your old barangay's portal.
- Your old barangay office can also mark you as moved out. Ask them if you can no longer sign in there.

## What stays with your old barangay
- Your record, your document requests, your receipts and your verification stay with the barangay where you lived. Nothing is moved to your new barangay.
- Your old barangay can no longer see anything you do in your new one.

## Registering in your new barangay
- Open your new barangay's portal and register with the same mobile number. See [Create your account on the website](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/create-account-website).
- You send your ID for verification again in your new barangay: each barangay checks its own residents.
- If you register before you are marked as moved out, you see **"Already Registered"** with your old barangay's name. Mark yourself as moved out there first.

## If you come back
- If you try to sign in to your old barangay's portal after you moved out, you see "No account uses this number in", then the barangay's name, and no code is sent.
- If you try to register there again, you see "Welcome back" after you type your code, with "You moved out of this barangay, and your records here are kept. To live here again, ask the barangay office to restore your account."
- Your old barangay office restores your record. This works only while your number is not registered in another barangay.

## If something goes wrong
- **"Already Registered"** names a barangay that is not yours: contact that barangay's office, or chat with BarangayOS support.
- You cannot sign in to your old barangay's portal anymore: that is expected after you move out. See [Account Not Found and Already Registered explained](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/sign-in-messages).

## When to ask for help
- **Contact your barangay office** where you lived before to be marked as moved out, or to have your record restored if you come back.
- **Chat with BarangayOS support** if the website shows a barangay that is not yours.

Good news: Bebot now does more of your daily work right in the chat. You can see your lists, open a record and take its next step without leaving the conversation.

## Highlights

### Bebot shows your work in the chat

Ask Bebot what needs attention, and it shows your lists and records as cards you can work on. You can review a request, verify a resident or record a payment without leaving the chat.

![A new chat with Bebot, with the What needs attention today question outlined (desktop)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdDBKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--423ef5dfca9ddc4d9002dd5dc9876c9b2b7819bf/hc-e53487ca5bc77166.webp?cw_image_width=694px)

![A new chat with Bebot, with the What needs attention today question outlined (phone)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdDRKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ed463a04ca27f133c1a3ba9a842884fb99d5ecf7/hc-0da36b011d3e3e22.webp?cw_image_width=356px)

**Try it**

1. In the sidebar, click **Bebot**.
2. Click **What needs attention today?**, or type your question where it says **Ask Bebot anything**.
3. Click a count on the chart to see its list, then click **Review** on a row.
4. In the record, click its next step, like **Start Review**. Check the card, then confirm it, or click **Not now**.

> **Tip:** Bebot never changes a record until you confirm it, and shows only what your role can already see.

### Open a request or resident by number

Already have the number in front of you? Give it to Bebot, and it opens that document request or resident record straight away.

**Try it**

1. In the sidebar, click **Bebot**.
2. Type a request's tracking number, like BGY-2026-00012, or a resident's number, like RES-2026-00001, and send it.
3. After Bebot shows a list, ask it to open "the first one", or name a row by what it shows.

> **Tip:** A number from another barangay finds nothing, and Bebot tells you so.

## Features

- **Bebot shows your lists:** Bebot now shows the document queue, residents waiting for verification, bills, today's appointments, the complaints and ideas inbox and open SOS reports as lists in the chat. **Review** opens a record right under its row.
- **Next steps in the chat:** Cards let you review a request, verify a resident, record a payment, send a reminder, cancel a bill, book a walk-in, or reply to a report. Each step waits on a card until you confirm it. Steps with details, such as a payment, open the same window as on their page.
- **Needs attention chart:** Bebot can show a **Needs attention** chart of what is waiting. Each count opens its own list.
- **Requests and posts from the chat:** Bebot can set up a document request for a resident on the new-request form. The new-post form opens over the chat with Bebot's draft in it, and a post's record offers **Publish**, **Archive** and **Pin to top**.
- **Open by number:** Bebot opens a document request by its tracking number, or a resident by their resident number. After it shows a list, you can ask it to open one of the rows.
- **Fuller cards for residents:** Residents now see their requests, bills, receipts, appointments, reports and news as full cards in Bebot's chat. They can pay a bill, cancel a request, or book and reschedule an appointment there.

## Improvements

- **The chart keeps your choice:** The count you choose on the **Needs attention** chart stays selected while its list is open. Choose it again to close the list, and reach the counts with the keyboard too.
- **Tidier lists and charts:** Bebot's lists no longer show an empty actions column, and a chart's labels no longer sit on its bars.
- **Problems stay small:** If one message in Bebot's chat, or a record opened under a row, cannot be shown, only that part says so. The rest of the chat stays as it is.

## Fixes

- **Overdue bills:** On **Finance** > **Billing**, the **Overdue** filter now fills each page, longest overdue first. Before, a page could come back short or empty while overdue bills waited further down. Bebot's list of unpaid bills also reaches past the first 200.
- **Report updates:** If you take a report off the public board and publish it again while its page stays open, **Who can see this** now keeps its choice. Before, it came up empty.
- **Bebot and your other barangays:** If you work in more than one barangay and open another in a new tab or on another device, Bebot now waits instead of breaking. It shows **Use Bebot here**, which brings Bebot and your chat back.
- **The right row:** Asking Bebot to open "the first one" now opens the first row you see. Bebot also no longer says a card is open while it is still loading.
- **Safer document access requests:** When someone asks to see a resident's document from its verification page, the owner's text and email now carry only BarangayOS's own words. This keeps residents safer from misleading messages. Each document also takes only five access requests at once, then about five a day.

That's all for this update. Thank you for the care you put into your barangay's work every day.

Enter how many and **What happened**, then click **Report**. The units are set aside until someone who can approve write-offs clicks **Review** on the Items page and chooses **Approve** or **Reject**. If your own role can approve write-offs, your report is written off at once.

## Before you start

- **Permission needed:** to report, **Give out & lend** or **Add & edit items** under **Inventory**. A new barangay gives both to Super Admin, Admin and Treasury. To approve or reject, **Approve write-offs**, which goes to Super Admin and Admin only. Your barangay may have changed this.
- Report only units that are on the shelf. For borrowed equipment that came back damaged or not at all, use **Take back** on the borrowing instead: see [Lend equipment and take it back](https://chat.zentech.ph/hc/barangay-os/articles/staff-inventory-borrowing).

## Steps to report lost or damaged units

1. On **Inventory** > **Items**, click the item's name.

   ![An item's row in the Items list with its name outlined (desktop)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdndGIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--76f62151014a16b7eec3fd038921c9852615bb3f/hc-3fa2acf911628059.webp?cw_image_width=966px)

   ![An item's line in the Items list outlined (phone)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdjBGIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c717aaf1a47f51ea10c48364a734b1a0e91106ec/hc-cf8746d37f881b66.webp?cw_image_width=390px)

   On a phone, open the sidebar first with the menu button at the top left of the page, then click **Inventory** > **Items**.

2. Click **Lost or damaged**. The "Report lost or damaged" window opens.

   ![The item's page with the Lost or damaged button outlined (desktop)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdjRGIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7f1d3b3823221157f490f70f9c054fbe26f6d9f3/hc-99a0fc5ce81ca3bc.webp?cw_image_width=1280px)

   ![The item's page with the Lost or damaged button outlined (phone)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdjhGIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6df93a4c1ccf5adccd4e70fb8a3a346a7741f3b6/hc-0ec83663cb07875f.webp?cw_image_width=390px)

   In the Items list on a computer, the row's menu (three dots) calls it **Report lost or damaged**.

3. Enter **How many**, the **Date**, and **What happened**: **Lost**, **Damaged**, **Expired**, **Disposed of** or **Something else**.

   ![The What happened list outlined in the Report lost or damaged window (desktop)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0FHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7e6e63d4bbd932eb0436d50fbf56d8a95a8da3a2/hc-696f85736f15d3a0.webp?cw_image_width=480px)

   ![The What happened list outlined in the Report lost or damaged window (phone)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0VHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--37f01b5f0168807f6863c38200cb6525911a9d22/hc-d6e5bd4ce2d10179.webp?cw_image_width=390px)

   Under **More details (optional)** you can add a **Note** and a **Photo (optional)**.

4. Click **Report**.

   ![The Report button outlined at the bottom of the window (desktop)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0lHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--678c881abed9145df7463d2e3ad92450ff419b44/hc-9b2ff52c53acce98.webp?cw_image_width=480px)

   ![The Report button outlined at the bottom of the window (phone)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ01HIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--23e224c4c4b7ea7646aef461a4b9030ffb5e7018/hc-36140ad88188074e.webp?cw_image_width=390px)

   If your role cannot approve write-offs, the window says "An approver has to confirm this. Until then these units are set aside, so nobody gives them out or lends them." You then see a message that starts "Sent for approval." If your role can approve them, you see a message that starts "Wrote off".

## Steps to approve or reject a write-off

1. On **Inventory** > **Items**, find the notice that says how many write-offs need your approval, and click **Review**. The "Write-offs to approve" panel opens.

   ![The Items page with the Review button outlined in the approval notice (desktop)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ1FHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--840e5949ffc9ea15d51ab9b583a195e7fcbee794/hc-72c511b733b7ad67.webp?cw_image_width=1280px)

   ![The Items page with the Review button outlined in the approval notice (phone)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ1VHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--fa09e54ae242c8c0c64fd4706fab00377ccb74f4/hc-3cc37a5574ce457a.webp?cw_image_width=390px)

   On a phone, open the sidebar first with the menu button at the top left of the page, then click **Inventory** > **Items**.

   An item's page with units set aside has a **Review** button too.

2. Check each write-off: the item, how many, what happened, who reported it and when, the note and any files.

   ![A write-off outlined in the Write-offs to approve panel (desktop)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ1lHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--b71cdad340718d2e19c1550d3f796043acd11554/hc-3e9d3e3a6f36f0a0.webp?cw_image_width=477px)

   ![A write-off outlined in the Write-offs to approve panel (phone)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2NHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6b197bfe47665511865d34e0fe0e8de366657fb0/hc-e14beec24d0bae23.webp?cw_image_width=333px)

   A write-off from a borrowing also says where it came from: "Not returned by" the borrower, or "Came back damaged from" them.

3. Click **Approve** to take the units out of the inventory, or **Reject** to put them back.

   ![The Approve button outlined beside Reject in the panel (desktop)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2dHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e33dc4c50d6609d5e43ace6a15026b131970ac88/hc-ce6a843c7874ee49.webp?cw_image_width=477px)

   ![The Approve button outlined beside Reject in the panel (phone)](https://chat.zentech.ph/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ2tHIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--20d1ed8deaec40e18757a5303a2939867f081c43/hc-571131c024ef65bd.webp?cw_image_width=333px)

## What happens next

- While a write-off waits, its units are set aside: fewer are available, and the total stays the same. The item's page says how many are set aside: "Waiting for an approver. Until then nobody can give them out or lend them."
- The item's **History** shows **Set aside for write-off**.
- **Approve** takes the units out of the total. The **History** shows **Written off**, and you see a message that starts "Wrote off".
- **Reject** puts the units back on the shelf. The **History** shows **Write-off rejected**, and you see a message that ends "are back on the shelf".
- For units reported missing when a borrowing came back, **Reject** means the borrower still has them. The units go back on their borrowing, which is out again.
- No text or email is sent. Approvers see the count on the notice at the top of **Items**.

## Rules and limits

- You can report only what is on the shelf now: not more than is available.
- **How many** is a whole number, 1 or more. The date can be today or earlier.
- A photo is an image or a PDF, up to 10 MB.
- The panel shows up to 50 write-offs at a time, newest first.
- A write-off is decided once. After that it cannot be changed.

## Troubleshooting

| You see | Why | What to do |
|---|---|---|
| No **Lost or damaged** button | Your role lacks **Give out & lend** and **Add & edit items**, or the item is archived. | Ask your admin. |
| No **Review** button or no notice | Your role lacks **Approve write-offs**, or nothing is waiting. | Ask a Super Admin or Admin. |
| "Nothing is waiting for approval." | Every write-off is decided. | Nothing to do. |
| A message that says only a number of units "are available to" write off | Fewer units are on the shelf than you entered. | Enter fewer. Units lent out or already set aside do not count. |
| A message that starts "This write-off was already" | Someone else decided it first. | Nothing to do. |
| "The borrowing no longer shows these units as missing. Check the slip before deciding." | The borrowing changed after the report. | Open the borrowing and check it, then decide. |
| "Couldn't record the decision" or "Couldn't save this. Nothing was changed." | The change could not be saved. | Check your connection and try again. |
